active_rules.name: retry-paths-log-and-guard
active_rules.rule_text: Every retry/failure path must log start and abort with cause; acceptance criteria must include intended-failure (RED) counts and at least one guard test.

evidence.quote: B targets the validated P0 dossier (RED 3/3, GREEN 5/5, 2 guards) with per-attempt deadlines from config and logging on every failure path — exactly the review-bar constraints.
Retry claims to run but ReleaseRetryService bails on the cloned target without logging. Users think the release shipped; it never did.

dissent.text: One reviewer considered logging-only fixes sufficient without guard tests; preserved per the aug16 dissent rule.
